## User task and result / 使用场景与结果

Who encounters the problem, what are they trying to do, and what changes for them? Link the relevant issue and topic when useful.

谁在什么场景遇到了问题？修改后可以完成什么？必要时关联 Issue 和专题。

## Validation / 验证

State checks performed, the Mac architecture actually used and behavior not verified. Add a sanitized screenshot for UI changes. Documentation-only changes need content and link checks.

说明实际检查、实测 Mac 架构及未验证行为。界面改动附脱敏截图；纯文档改动核对内容与链接。

## Compatibility and documentation / 兼容与文档

Describe affected file types, limitations or migration effects. Update paired user documents when behavior changes; release notes need equivalent English and Chinese explanations.

说明受影响文件、限制或迁移影响。行为变化更新中英文用户文档；发布说明保持中英文等价。
